literal: Trade to those who do trade [is true] trade, protecting others' [goods] also like their own, if they do [it].
translation: For merchants, true trade consists in protecting the goods of others as they would protect their own.
modern: வியாபாரம் செய்பவர்களுக்கு முறையான வியாபாரம் என்பது, பிறருடைய பொருட்களையும் தங்களுடைய பொருட்களைப் போலப் பாதுகாத்து வியாபாரம் செய்தால் அமையும்.
explanation: This couplet defines fairness and integrity in commerce, which is a key aspect of neutrality (நடுவுநிலைமை). It states that true merchants must treat the goods and interests of their customers and others with the same care and honesty they show to their own. By protecting others' property as if it were their own, merchants establish trust and maintain ethical standards. The word 'பேணி' (protecting) highlights the active care required in business dealings, and 'தமபோல்' (like their own) sets the standard of empathy and fairness.
